newsitem.title: GERMANY: German economy slows to 1.4 pct growth in Q1.
newsitem.headline: German economy slows to 1.4 pct growth in Q1.

text.p: Germany's gross domestic product grew 1.4 percent in the first quarter of 1997 from the same quarter a year ago, the Federal Statistics Office said on Thursday.
Measured against the previous quarter, GDP was up 0.5 percent, rounded to the nearest half-percentage point, the office said.
Prior to the release of the data, economists' average expectations had been for growth of 2.7 percent year-on-year, and 0.4 percent quarter-on-quarter.
The economy had grown at a 1.9 percent-pace in the fourth quarter of 1996 and a 2.3 percent pace in the third quarter of last year.
The statistics office said, however, that three fewer work days in the first quarter of 1997 could have reduced growth by over one percentage point.
In west Germany, the economy grew 1.2 percent year-on-year while in east Germany it expanded 2.8 percent from the first quarter of 1996.
